title: May I restart Xcode's device service on the Mac? (fixes the phone test tool)
instructions: Xcode's background device service (CoreDeviceService, running 7 days) kept an old error from 11:1xZ, so the phone test tool can't start although Xcode's window shows no problem. Restarting it only reconnects Xcode to the iPhone (it restarts by itself in seconds; Xcode may show the phone as reconnecting). Answer yes or no.
